components.text: They called me Mechanist before the Ascension. Skyward charted wind, Wildlander beasts. I kept the gears.$(br)$(br)※ Margin notes are measurements. If a number is missing, the pack does not have it. I will not invent one.
I went to the lower islands to finish an automated line. The binding stayed on the bench. If you are reading this I am gone; I hope the machines still turn.
